profile.headline: Software Engineer at Equifax Workforce Solutions

positions.title: Web Developer & Web Designer
positions.description: In May of 2014 I began freelancing as a full-stack web developer & designer. I continue to work with clients on various projects from single page portfolio websites to educational software, e-commerce, and client management applications. Services I have provided have ranged from simple front-end adjustments to full front & back-end application builds from scratch.

positions.title: Building Floater
positions.description: Floating position covering a wide variety of jobs. Due to my ability to learn at an accelerated pace, I was certified at a trainer level for 27 different positions in under 4 years.

positions.title: Lead Person
positions.description: During my time at Gilster-Mary Lee Corporation I had the opportunity to lead and maintain several different food manufacturing lines. I provided direction to the line operators, and line workers, as well as providing all training.(on the job training, safety training, sanitation training.)  I provided English/Spanish translation services for management, employees, and occasionally the local hospital in emergency situations. I also attended several workman's compensation doctor visits with workers to provide translation services.

honors.title: Valedictorian
honors.issuer: Issued by Full Sail University · Mar 2015

honors.title: Web Standards Project Course Director's Award
honors.description: The Course Director's Award is given to students that exemplify the values of the class.
honors.issuer: Issued by Oscar Cortez: Associate Course Director for Web Design & Development Bachelor of Science Degree · Oct 2013
